scripts.typecheck: npm --workspaces --if-present run typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p apps/WebSoundMeter/tests/e2e/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/WebSpeakerSim/tests/e2e/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p docs/scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm --workspace web-sound-meter run build && npm --workspace web-speaker-sim run build
scripts.test:e2e: npm --workspace web-sound-meter run test:e2e && npm --workspace web-speaker-sim run test:e2e
scripts.docs:screenshots: tsc --noEmit -p docs/scripts/tsconfig.json && npm run build && node docs/scripts/generate-screenshots.ts
